Perfect! All changes are complete and tested. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

## Summary

I've successfully implemented the optional excerpt feature for the Guren blog application. The excerpt field is now optional on post creation and editing forms, with automatic derivation from the post body when not provided.

### Files Changed:

1. **`app/Utils/excerptDeriver.ts`** (new) — Implements the excerpt derivation logic:
   - Returns the full body if ≤ 140 characters
   - Truncates at 140 characters without cutting words in half
   - Appends the ellipsis character (…) for truncated text
   - Properly handles edge cases (no whitespace, word boundaries, trailing whitespace)

2. **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`** — Made excerpt optional:
   - Changed from required (`min(1)`) to optional (`.optional()`)
   - Empty strings are converted to `undefined`

3. **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`** — Applied excerpt derivation:
   - `store()` method now derives excerpt from body if not provided
   - `update()` method does the same, allowing updates without excerpt to re-derive from the new body
   - Both methods ensure the stored excerpt is always populated

4. **`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx`** — Updated form UX:
   - Shows "(optional)" indicator next to the Excerpt label
   - Added helpful placeholder: "If left blank, we'll use the beginning of the body"

5. **`resources/js/pages/posts/Edit.tsx`** — Same UX improvements as New.tsx

6. **`tests/PostController.test.ts`** — Added comprehensive tests:
   - 10 new tests covering all excerpt derivation scenarios
   - All 11 tests pass, 0 failures

The implementation maintains all existing validation (title and body remain required), preserves authorization (create/edit still require login), and ensures the stored excerpt is never empty. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass completely.
